blocks.text: SCHEDULE: 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals ANTIPOLO—Rondae Hollis-Jefferson put on another big performance as TNT dominated Magnolia, 91-73, to move on the cusp of sweeping their best-of-five 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinal series on Wednesday at Ynares Center here. Hollis-Jefferson finished with 39 points and 15 rebounds as the Tropang 5G gained a 2-0 lead behind a second-straight blowout that left the Hotshots on the brink of another playoff exit despite topping Group B.
